title: Rename packs.go → packs_core.go
description:
## What
After extracting packs_validate.go and packs_marketplace.go, rename the remaining `packs.go` to `packs_core.go`.

## What should remain (~1400 lines)
- Pack registry constants: `packRegistryScope`, `packRegistryID`, `packCatalogScope`, `packCatalogID`, `defaultPackCatalog*`, `envPackCatalog*`, `policyConfigScope`, `policyConfigID`, `policyConfigKey`
- `seedDefaultPackCatalogs` function
- All core type definitions: `packManifest`, `packMetadata`, `packCompatibility`, `packTopic`, `packResources`, `packResource`, `packOverlays`, `packConfigOverlay`, `packPolicyOverlay`, `packTests`, `packPolicySimulation*`, `packRecord`, `packRecordManifest`, `packRecordResources`, `packRecordOverlays`, `packAppliedConfigOverlay`, `packAppliedPolicyOverlay`, `schemaPlan`, `workflowPlan`, `appliedConfigChange`, `appliedPolicyChange`, `packVerifyResult`, `packInstallOptions`, `packInstallError`
- HTTP handlers: `handleListPacks`, `handleGetPack`, `handleInstallPack`, `handleUninstallPack`, `handleVerifyPack`
- Install workflow: `installPackFromDir`
- Planning & registration: `planSchemas`, `planWorkflows`, `registerSchema`, `registerWorkflow`, `saveWorkflowRequest`, `rollbackSchema`, `rollbackWorkflow`
- Overlay management: `applyConfigOverlay`, `removeConfigOverlay`, `restoreConfigOverlay`, `applyPolicyOverlay`, `removePolicyOverlay`, `restorePolicyOverlay`
- Policy simulation: `runPolicySimulation`, `normalizeDecision`
- Registry management: `loadPackRegistry`, `updatePackRegistry`, `savePackRegistry`, `recordsToAny`, `getConfigDoc`
- Lock helpers: `policyFragmentID`, `packLockOwner`, `acquirePackLocks`

## How
1. `git mv core/controlplane/gateway/packs.go core/controlplane/gateway/packs_core.go`
2. Clean up imports (remove any that are now unused)
3. Run `go build ./cmd/cordum-api-gateway`

## Notes
- Use `git mv` to preserve history
- After this step, the entire Part 1 (file split) is complete
definitionOfDone: packs_core.go exists with the remaining pack code
Import block is clean (no unused imports)
